title: Mushroom and Cheese Galette
subtitle: with a basil and parmesan crust
description: A rustic free-form pie with a buttery parmesan and basil crust, filled with mixed cheeses and sauteed mushrooms. Like a quiche without the fuss.

steps.text: Make the dough: process the flour, salt and cold cubed butter in a food processor until crumbly. Add the parmesan and basil and process again. Add the sour cream and process only until a ball of dough forms. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate.
Heat olive oil in a pan and saute the mushrooms with salt and pepper until soft. Add some parmesan, stir and remove from the heat.
Mix the cheeses together in a bowl until uniform and salt to taste.
Roll the chilled dough out on well-floured baking paper into a large round or rectangle.
Place the cheese filling in the centre, top with the mushrooms and leave a clean border. Fold the edges in to make a half-open pie.
Brush the dough with milk and sprinkle generously with sesame seeds. Transfer to a baking tray with the baking paper and bake for 35-40 minutes, until the pastry is browned. Serve hot.
